record.paper: The hat guessing number of graphs

dossier_meta.paper: The hat guessing number of graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Do there exist functions $f_i : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, $1 \leq i \leq 3$ such that (i) if the maximum degree of $G$ is $\Delta$, then $HG(G) \leq f_1(\Delta)$; (ii) if $G$ is $d$-degenerate, then $HG(G) \leq f_2(d)$; (iii) if the minimum degree of $G$ is $\delta$, then $HG(G) \geq f_3(\delta)$, and $f_3(\delta)$ tends to infinity when $\delta$ tends to infinity.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors seek to understand how basic graph parameters control the hat guessing number. The existence of $f_1$ is already known via the Lovász Local Lemma ($HG(G) < e^\Delta$), but whether $f_2$ (degeneracy bound) or $f_3$ (minimum-degree lower bound) exist is unclear. Theorems 1.6 and 1.8 provide partial progress toward part (ii).
